$schema_note: The four inspection viewports. Names are canonical — screenshot directories, finding records, and pass assignments all use them verbatim. Breakpoint context: Tailwind md=768, lg=1024; the site's own suites measure at 1440 and 390.

viewports.name: desktop-1440
viewports.notes: primary buyer viewport; all historical width measurements are at 1440

viewports.name: tablet-1024
viewports.notes: sits exactly on the lg breakpoint — layout-switch defects live here

viewports.name: tablet-834
viewports.notes: iPad Air portrait; between md and lg — the least-tested band

viewports.name: mobile-390
viewports.notes: below md: single-column, mobile menu, touch targets (WCAG 2.5.8 24px floor)

device_emulation_note: use plain viewport sizing via _harness/browser.js contexts; do not enable touch/deviceScaleFactor emulation unless a pass file says so — historical measurements were taken without it
